evidence.note: Apple Silicon macOS 13+ only; Windows and Intel Macs unsupported. Independent unsigned app; other cameras are not supported.

Sorts original DJI Osmo Pocket 4P, 4 and 3 footage into folders by documented Log/HLG/Normal profile, resolution, frame rate and slow motion before grading. Moves files without re-encoding and can undo sorting. Sort before editing: existing projects need relinking afterward. Edited clips without DJI metadata remain unknown.
